purpose: Rerun the 004/005 parity forensics through both the low-level projection/compositor APIs and the public PhysicsInterpolator CPU/CUDA path, with complete DVS backend cross checks.

comparison_design.same_projection_input: NumPy and CUDA compositors each receive the same serialized float32 uv/z/valid arrays from one projector.
comparison_design.independent_projection: Compare NumPy float64 geometry with Torch float64 ray/SE3/projection geometry, both returning float32 uv/z; feed each projection into both compositors.
comparison_design.torch_projection_precision: Float64 alphas, camera/object poses, intrinsics, rays and SE3/projection geometry at both core and public caller; float32 uv/z outputs.
comparison_design.event_paths: For both projection sources and both reconstruction backends, run identical initial state and timestamps through CPU and CUDA DVS.
comparison_design.invalid_pixel_policy: hold I1 at alpha=0.5, matching the archived causal replay
comparison_design.production_interpolator: Run public PhysicsInterpolator with the same cached endpoints and adaptive sample schedule on NumPy and CUDA; compare every intermediate support mask, supported log-luminance, and CPU/CUDA DVS outputs.

controls: coverage at and one float32 ULP around the 0.995 threshold
tiny positive footprint remains visible but unsupported
front/back occlusion preserves nearest surface radiance
threshold-adjacent DVS probes for both polarities

acceptance.note: These are the previously frozen parity criteria; the supported-mask and supported-luminance gates apply to each backend native end-to-end projection plus compositor. This forensic run does not relax them. Renderer fidelity, intermediate-radiance sampling, render cost, and closed-loop perception remain separate acceptance items. The public PhysicsInterpolator multi-sample path must also satisfy the same mask/luminance limits and its CPU/CUDA DVS event-count delta must remain within the frozen 0.02 bound.
